paragraphs.text: Students who prepare to explain a topic to others remember it better than students who prepare for a test on the same material, even when neither group ever teaches anyone.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The reason seems to be the way the material is organised. A person expecting to explain looks for a thread and for the places where a listener would stop and ask, and both force a second pass through the text.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The effect is easy to lose. If the explanation is read aloud from notes, the gain disappears, and students who prepare in a group often divide the work and learn only their part.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Schools use the idea in small doses. One class ends each week with five minutes in which two pupils explain what was learned, without notes, to pupils from a younger year.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Students who prepare to explain a topic to others remember it better

explanation.en: A finding about preparation: preparing to explain beats preparing for a test → i.
explanation.kk: Дайындық туралы байқау: түсіндіруге дайындалу тестке дайындалудан тиімді → i.
explanation.ru: Наблюдение о подготовке: объяснять помогает больше, чем готовиться к тесту → i.

items.quote: The reason seems to be the way the material is organised.
keywords: the way the material is organised

explanation.en: Why it works: looking for a thread and for questions → ii.
explanation.kk: Неге жұмыс істейді: желі мен сұрақ туатын жерді іздейді → ii.
explanation.ru: Почему работает: ищут нить и места вопросов → ii.

items.quote: The effect is easy to lose.

explanation.en: How the gain is lost: reading from notes, dividing the work → iii.
explanation.kk: Әсер қалай жоғалады: қағаздан оқу, жұмысты бөлу → iii.
explanation.ru: Как эффект теряется: чтение по бумажке, деление работы → iii.

items.quote: One class ends each week with five minutes in which two pupils explain what was learned

explanation.en: A classroom routine: five minutes of explaining each week → iv.
explanation.kk: Мектеп тәжірибесі: апта соңында бес минут түсіндіру → iv.
explanation.ru: Школьная практика: пять минут объяснений в конце недели → iv.
